title: Elise C NDE 7444
content: Everything started two days before my experience. I got information about the death of a loved sick person. I was very disturbed. I decide to join my friends at the beach, to get a change of air after having remained inside during two days. I was walking quietly when I saw a truck for blood donation. I always wanted to give my blood in order to save others and above all helping people in distress. I donated my blood and everything went fine. I felt liberated. A few hours later, with my friends, we decided to walk home. However, while walking, I started to feel like vomiting and my head started spinning. Then black spots in the eyes, fear was rising in me. I was clinging on my friend just before slumping down. What I experienced during this loss of consciousness really seemed to be taking hours and at the same time only milliseconds. I found myself in a very luminous place with a slight sensation of mist, when I looked to the distance. This space seemed without limit to me, like a void filled with light. At this precise moment, I was on a wooden merry-go-round. I was sitting, I don't know where, maybe on a horse. I was calm and felt very well. I asked myself no questions, as I didn't remember my fainting. For me, I had 6 years, and was enjoying being on a merry-go-round all alone. Then a forearm with a hand of a person came out of nowhere, as if she showed me why I was here. If was like a camera was showing me that I was unconscious. This hand had a meaning after I understood what had happened to me. I had the choice to stay in this place or to go back. I got a feeling of guilt; I didn't want to abandon my relatives. So, I chose to catch that hand. I woke on the ground, with all my friends around me. I had difficulties admitting what had happened. A week later, I talked about it with my friend. He replied to me that he felt an ‘energy’: like a gust of wind that hit him. This testimony helped me a lot to convince myself that I wasn't crazy. This changed my life considerably.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A seemingly limitless space, "like a void filled with light."

arrival.other_being_detail: A "forearm with a hand" that "came out of nowhere" and seemed to show her why she was there; she chose to catch the hand to return.

environment.environment_other_detail: Very luminous place with a slight sensation of mist; limitless space/void filled with light; she was on a wooden merry-go-round (possibly on a horse).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fainting/loss of consciousness after donating blood earlier that day; developed nausea, spinning head, black spots, then slumped down.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Wooden merry-go-round experience; a hand/forearm appeared and she chose to catch it to return; friend later reported feeling an 'energy' like a gust of wind.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No reported OBE; experience begins directly in a luminous void-like realm with the merry-go-round, followed by a choice to return and awakening.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She experienced being "6 years" old and alone on a wooden merry-go-round (possibly on a horse) within a limitless luminous void; a forearm/hand appeared "out of nowhere" and functioned like showing her ("like a camera") that she was unconscious.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "This space seemed without limit to me, like a void filled with light."; "For me, I had 6 years"; "I had the choice to stay in this place or to go back."; "He replied to me that he felt an ‘energy’: like a gust of wind that hit him."
